extraction.synopsis: In the harbour town of Corvel Quay, lamp-keeper Tomas Hale shows his apprentice Ines Varro that the page of the Salt Ledger for the night of the Gannet wreck, nine years ago, has been cut out. Their friend Bram Ostrow, a Guild journeyman, hears that Tomas asked Guild master Sabine Oake to reopen the inquiry and was refused. Odile Marr, master of the ship Kestrel and a survivor of the Gannet, arrives and asks to speak with Tomas. Tomas tells Ines that on the night of the wreck someone with a key was inside the locked lamp room, and that only the keeper and the Guild master hold keys.
